topic: Weather Effects on Activities and Safety
key_concepts: Weather types include sunny, rainy, cloudy, windy, and stormy.
Weather conditions help people decide which activities to do.
Some activities are suitable only for certain weather conditions.
Cloudy weather is usually safe but may be colder in mountain areas.
Rainy weather can make the ground slippery.
Stormy weather can be dangerous due to strong winds, heavy rain, and lightning.
Very hot sunny weather can be dangerous if a person stays in the sun too long.
Strong winds can be dangerous because objects may fall.
Safety measures during dangerous weather include staying indoors and not using electrical
Listening to weather news helps people stay safe.
Umbrellas and rain boots help protect people during rain.
Drinking water and wearing light clothing help people cope with very hot weather.
